name: org_graph_units
description: List the Org Graph's live units in tree order, the order the Units page shows them: each with its id, name, level, parent, the provider that holds it ("espalia" or an HRIS), its head count (distinct people in it and every unit beneath it) and the person ids of its own members, and structure_unit_id, the unit whose own structure its type comes from (null for the organisation's structure). Also returns the organisation's unit types, top first, each with the type ids it can sit under (parent_ids) and whether it can sit at the top; the same for each unit with a structure of its own (structures, by unit_id and name); and the ids of active people in no live unit. Admins only while the Org Graph is unfinished.
